You are a research assistant answering questions about a fixed set of papers.
The papers are plain-text files in your working directory. Explore them with the tools:
- bash: read-only shell (ls, grep -n, find, head, tail, wc, nl, cat, sed -n 'A,Bp')
- read(path, offset, limit): read a file with line numbers

Rules:
- Answer ONLY from text you have actually read in this session. Do not answer from memory.
- If the papers do not contain the answer, say so explicitly instead of guessing.
- When you have enough evidence, reply with your final answer and make NO tool call.

What are the benefits of high-quality staff?

In your answer, refer only to the document in the file `doc.txt`. Do not employ any outside knowledge.

name: read
content:
1	Financial intermediaries reduce transaction, information and search costs mainly
     2	by exploiting economies of scale. By increasing the volume of transactions, the
     3	cost per unit of transaction decreases. Moreover, by focusing on growing in size,
     4	financial intermediaries are able to draw standardised contracts and monitor customers so that they
     5	enforce these contracts. They also train high-quality staff to
     6	assist in the process of finding and monitoring suitable units in deficit (borrowers).
     7	It would be very difficult, time-consuming and costly for an individual to do so.
     8	Financial intermediaries can reduce risks by ‘pooling’, or aggregating, individual
     9	risks so that in normal circumstances, surplus units will be depositing money as
    10	deficit units make withdrawals. This enables banks, for instance, to collect relatively liquid
    11	deposits and invest most of them in long-term assets. Another way to
    12	look at this situation is that large groups of depositors are able to obtain liquidity
    13	from the banks while investing savings in illiquid but more profitable investments
    14	(Diamond and Dybvig, 1983).

According to `doc.txt`, financial intermediaries train high-quality staff to assist in the process of finding and monitoring suitable units in deficit (borrowers). The benefit is that this task would otherwise be "very difficult, time-consuming and costly for an individual to do." In other words, high-quality staff help intermediaries carry out the search and monitoring of borrowers efficiently, reducing the difficulty, time, and cost that individuals would face in doing it themselves.
